Open the council guide: VoiceOver label of the glass safari button, top trailing on the Guide; opens the council's own page for the bin on screen
Booked collection: Small uppercase eyebrow above 'Inorganic Collection' on the Guide: this service is booked, not on a regular schedule
Not in your schedule: Small uppercase eyebrow above a bin's name on the Guide when the council collects this bin but the household has not set it up in its schedule
%@ · %@: Small uppercase eyebrow above a bin's name on the Guide: frequency, then weekday (e.g. 'Weekly · Tuesday'). First %@ is 'Weekly' or 'Fortnightly', second is the weekday name
%@, page %lld of %lld: VoiceOver label of the Guide's page indicator (lid spheres): bin name, current page number, page count. e.g. 'Rubbish, page 1 of 4'
Yes: Small uppercase heading of the column of items that go in this bin (Guide)
No: Small uppercase heading of the column of items that must not go in this bin (Guide)
